scope: All baseline trades; pre-entry price geometry only; chronological second-half OOS; no threshold optimization

methodology.impulse: strongest directionally aligned candle in the previous 20 bars, normalized by preceding 60-bar median true range
methodology.retracement: maximum adverse excursion after impulse and before entry, divided by impulse true range
methodology.entryLocation: entry position measured from impulse origin toward impulse extreme
methodology.distanceFromExtreme: remaining distance from entry to impulse extreme divided by impulse range
methodology.delay: bars between selected impulse and entry
methodology.compression: median TR of last up to 5 pre-entry bars divided by median TR of preceding up to 10 pre-entry bars
methodology.stopToImpulse: trade risk distance divided by selected impulse true range
methodology.lookahead: all features use candles strictly before entry
methodology.promotionGate: OOS bucket requires n >= 10, PF >= 1, avgR > 0; diagnostic only

nextResearchQuestion: Only investigate geometry features whose OOS bucket is positive with adequate sample; then test compact combinations on untouched chronological thirds.
